observability.policy: Evidence strength widens or narrows a claim. It never excludes a road from simulation or from a closure study; only an unresolvable input is fail-closed.

measurement_level.detail: this carriageway is measured; its value is level-1

temporal_support.detail: weekend and 21:00–05:00 predictions are extrapolation: the deployed training band is weekday 06–20; the raw table is absent, so day-level support is unmeasured

feature_compatibility.detail: training profile features are computed from BOTH directions; a single-direction station can only supply its own side, so the same feature name would not mean the same thing — the v2 table keeps the two under separate names

effective_sample_size.detail: hours within one station-day are strongly correlated; the independent unit is a day block, not a row

gate_m_reasons: raw directional counts unavailable: the count model was not evaluated
no independent day blocks: the aggregated table cannot support a blocked-date fold, so future-day transfer is unmeasured
calibration_support.detail: point transfer is benchmarked; the q10/q90 interval's nominal 80% coverage is still unvalidated, so it is a stress band, not a probability statement

local_crosscheck.detail: no published per-direction volume for this station; the split rests on transfer plus conservation

edges.usage: central profile with a weaker claim and wider stated uncertainty
